source: MAFF Department of Agricultural Extension / Directorate General of Agriculture, "បច្ចេកទេសដាំដុះសណ្តែកសៀង" [Soybean cultivation techniques], official extension manual, 2018
text:
Two planting methods are given with specific spacing recommendations: dibbling/hole-planting with 40–50cm between rows, 30cm within rows, 2–4 seeds per hole spaced roughly 3–5cm apart within the hole; and drill/furrow planting at 40–50cm row spacing with seed dropped continuously along the furrow at 3–4cm intervals.

Mechanized planting is illustrated with a tractor-drawn multi-row precision planter photo. Seeding depth and seed-to-soil contact are stressed for even germination, and the manual gives a seed-rate reference (approximately 60–70 kg/ha for the varieties in common use, with roughly 20–25 seeds per 100g being one seed-lot quality check example given). Weed-control chemical options at planting are named: Acetachlor/Alachlor pre-emergence herbicide at 9–2 liters per hectare (rate range as printed), and a combination product Fomesafen + quizalofop for post-emergence broadleaf/grass control at 1 mixed with 1 liter per hectare, applied at 2 liters of mix per hectare.
